title: Financing Certificate Platform for a Berlin Fintech
excerpt: How we built a full-stack fintech application with a conversion-optimized landing page, automated PDF certificate generation, and an admin dashboard for OHYP GmbH -- a company helping property buyers get financing proof within 24 hours.
challenge: OHYP GmbH needed a digital platform to issue personal financing certificates for real estate buyers in Germany. The existing process was manual and slow. They required a solution where buyers could receive a binding certificate within 24 hours -- without a SCHUFA credit inquiry -- while the system automatically compared over 550 partner banks.
solution: We developed a full-stack platform with a 10-step financing form as the core conversion element, automated PDF certificate generation with one-click download, and an admin dashboard for managing the complete request lifecycle. The platform uses tRPC for end-to-end type safety, PostgreSQL for data persistence, and Better Auth for secure session management.

testimonial.quote: webvise delivered a production-ready fintech platform that exceeded our expectations. The automated certificate flow and the conversion-optimized funnel have become core to how we operate. Reliable, fast, and always thinking ahead.
testimonial.author: R. Hainbach
